scoring_justification: Recomputing the full SMM Raman spectrum or tight-binding band structure in the verifier sandbox is infeasible; comparing reported peak frequencies and gap to paper-derived reference with tolerances is the feasible fallback.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference BLM peak frequencies and band gap for the (15,11)-(16,12) and (8,6)-(9,7) dimers as reported in the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'the ZZ polarized Raman spectrum of the (15-11)-(16-12) dimer displays four peaks located at 102 (BM4), 118 (BM3), 125 (BM2) and 128 cm^{-1} (BM1).' and 'a dimer gap close to 0.72 eV.'
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper-reported quantities; the task is to reproduce them by executing the scientific workflow described in the instruction.

outputs.description: Scored output containing the four BLM peak frequencies (mode identifiers and values in cm^-1). The checker compares each frequency against a hidden paper-derived reference within a tolerance.
Scored output containing the band gap of the (8,6)-(9,7) dimer. The checker compares the reported gap against a hidden paper-derived reference value within a tolerance.

output_contract.notes: All process steps produce intermediate evidence files that may be examined but are not directly scored. The two scored artifacts are the frequencies and the band gap.
